# Critical ECR/Inspector findings this deployment accepts, and until when.
#
# Format, whitespace separated:
#   <CVE-ID>  <expires YYYY-MM-DD>  <reason>
#
# Rules the gate enforces:
#   - A critical finding not listed here blocks the deploy.
#   - A listed finding past its expiry date blocks the deploy, so an accepted
#     risk has to be re-argued rather than inherited.
#   - Anything accepted is printed in the run summary, so it is visible in the
#     deploy log rather than only in this file.
#
# This exists because "no critical findings, ever, with no way to say otherwise"
# is not a security posture — it is an outage waiting for an upstream maintainer.
# Nine criticals on puppeteer, all fixed: NotAvailable, held ten commits for a
# day. The answer there was to stop installing puppeteer (see Dockerfile), which
# is why this file is empty: an unreachable package should be removed, not
# excused. Reach for this only when the package is genuinely needed at runtime
# and no fixed version exists.
